title: El cliente
goal: Explain a delay to somebody who does not want to hear it
culture: Bad news first and in four words. Then a real day — not ahorita and not mañana, both of which mean neither. Then one apology, once: apologising three times makes it sound like it is going to happen again.

beats.es: Vengo por lo mío. ¿Ya está listo?
beats.good: Say it first and plainly. Everything after this is easier once the bad news is out of the way in four words.
A day you can keep. Ahorita and mañana are what people say when they mean neither, and he has heard both already this week.

beats.en: I’ll let you know when it’s done.
beats.good: Le aviso — I will let you know. The same word the neighbour used about the water coming back, and it carries the same obligation.

beats.es: Está bien, joven. Aquí lo espero.
beats.good: Once, and then stop. Apologising three times makes it sound like it is going to happen again.
